I recently got my makeup done by Siddhesha Makeup Artist and had an absolutely wonderful experience. She did a fabulous job and understood exactly what I wanted from the very beginning. I was looking for a soft, subtle look, and she delivered it perfectly without going overboard. I really appreciate how patiently she listened to my preferences and matched the makeup to my skin tone and outfit so well.

The products she used felt light and comfortable throughout the event, and the overall look stayed intact for hours without any touch-ups. Her professionalism, calm nature, and attention to detail really stood out. The entire process was smooth, and I felt completely at ease while getting ready.

If you’re someone who prefers elegant, natural-looking makeup or even something more glamorous, I’m sure she’ll do a great job. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable and talented makeup artist!

featured_reviews.name: Manisha Vishe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely Amazing Experience! 👏

I had the pleasure of getting my makeup done by Siddhesha, and I must say it was an unforgettable experience! Siddhesha is not only a highly professional and talented makeup artist, but also incredibly supportive and kind throughout the entire process.

The makeup was so natural yet stunning, enhancing my features perfectly without feeling overdone. I received so many compliments, and everyone kept asking, "Who did your makeup?" It truly made me feel confident and beautiful!

Thank you, Siddhesha, for your incredible work and passion-your artistry goes beyond makeup. You made me feel special, and I'm so grateful. I highly recommend Siddhesha to anyone looking for flawless, elegant, and personalized makeup.

Keep shining and spreading beauty everywhere you go!

featured_reviews.name: ANAGHA GHOLAP

I really appreciate her dedication and I would recommend her art work to anyone looking for making their day beautiful.
